sets.title: Recognize
sets.description: Identify the meaning of colloquial particles (же, -то, ну, ведь) and set phrases
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите значение разговорных частиц (же, -то, ну, ведь) и устойчивых выражений

items.prompt:
Я же тебе говорил!
What does же add here?
items.promptEnglish: I DID tell you! / I told you, remember?
items.hint: Же stresses that this was already said or known.
items.explanation: Же adds emphasis and a sense of 'but I already told you!' It reminds the listener of something previously stated.

items.prompt:
Ты ведь знаешь об этом?
What does ведь express?
items.promptEnglish: You DO know about this, don't you? / After all, you know about this?
items.hint: Ведь appeals to shared knowledge or expected agreement.
items.explanation: Ведь signals that the speaker assumes the listener already knows or should agree: 'after all,' 'surely,' 'you do know.'

items.prompt:
Где-то я это видел.
What does -то add to где?
items.promptEnglish: I saw this somewhere (can't quite recall where).
items.hint: The suffix -то on question words creates indefinite pronouns.
items.explanation: Где-то = somewhere (vague). The suffix -то attached to question words (кто-то, что-то, когда-то) creates indefinite forms with a casual, slightly vague flavor.

items.prompt:
Он-то знает правду.
What nuance does -то give here?
items.promptEnglish: HE knows the truth (implying others might not).
items.hint: When -то attaches to a specific noun or pronoun, it contrasts that person with others.
items.explanation: Он-то знает = HE (at least) knows. The suffix -то on a definite noun/pronoun adds contrastive stress: this person does, even if others don't.

items.prompt:
Ну ты даёшь!
What does this colloquial expression mean?
items.promptEnglish: A reaction to someone's surprising behavior.
options: You're unbelievable! / Wow, you're something else!
items.answer: You're unbelievable! / Wow, you're something else!
items.hint: Ну ты даёшь is a set colloquial phrase expressing astonishment.
items.explanation: Ну ты даёшь! is a fixed colloquial expression meaning 'You're unbelievable!' or 'I can't believe you!' Used when someone does something surprising or outrageous.

minimalPairs.context: Someone asks 'What did you say?' Choose the colloquial version:
minimalPairs.explanation: Чего? is a colloquial truncation of Что ты сказал? or just 'What?' Used constantly in casual speech. Что вы сказали? is polite/formal.

minimalPairs.context: Choose the version with the emphatic particle же:
minimalPairs.explanation: Же adds emotional emphasis: 'I DID tell you!' / 'I already told you, remember?' The version without же is a calm neutral statement.

minimalPairs.context: Someone says something surprising. Choose the colloquial reaction:
minimalPairs.explanation: Да ладно! with rising intonation = 'No way! / You're kidding!' Much more colloquial than the formal Неужели.

translation.english: But I already told you! (emphatic, with же)
translation.hint: Же after я for emphatic reminder.

translation.english: Well, I don't know... (hesitation, with ну)
translation.hint: Ну at the start = well, um (hesitation filler).
Ведь = after all, surely. Goes near the subject.
Suffix -то on он contrasts him with others.
